name: f0-check
description: step F0 books check: 330 s at MAX (seed 5), the whole dish lit, springs; resizes at 60 s and 120 s, 20 predators at 90 s, the three designed tissues placed at 100 s, wild genomes (G) at 150 s, key M off and on, turnover mode and back, a snapshot saved and loaded at 280 s: atoms and charge rounding must stay 0; the job census every 30 s

evals.js: const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.3, v.cssH * 0.35, 'soap', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.5, 'oil', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.6, 'light', 1e9); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.6, 'heavy', 1e9); return moire.matter.springs.map(s => s.kind)

const v = moire.control.view(); const out = []; for (const [k, n] of [['plant', 0.3], ['filament', 0.5], ['biofilm', 0.7]]) out.push(await moire.tissues.place(k, { x: v.cssW * n, y: v.cssH * 0.5, n: 30 })); return JSON.stringify(out)
const S = await moire.snapshot({ grid: true }); const r = await moire.loadSnapshot(S); return { exact: r.exact, notes: r.notes, rounding: r.rounding }
const s = moire.cells.stats; return JSON.stringify({t: s && s.time, job: s && s.job, alive: moire.cells.alive})
